item.title: ArgoCD in practice: GitOps made simple
item.description: GitOps is the standard for deploying to Kubernetes, and ArgoCD is its most popular implementation. A hands-on review: how it works, why it’s different from a classic CI/CD pipeline, and how to structure your deployments.
